title: Evidence discipline
description: 证据诚实底线：先说清可观察的成功标准，分开观察与推断，披露有实质影响的不确定性，且只在对因果结论下判断时要求保留条件的对照。适用于全部主/子 Agent。
descriptionEn: Evidence honesty baseline: define observable success criteria before acting, separate observations from inferences, disclose uncertainty that materially affects the result, and compare against a baseline with relevant conditions held fixed before claiming a causal effect. Applies to all main and delegated Agents.

title: Scope and warranted complexity
description: 反无依据的预防性复杂化：不为假想的质疑者、风险或未来需求添加工作与说明，代码与文稿都取满足真实约束的最小方案，同时保留真实的安全检查与不确定性。适用于全部主/子 Agent。
descriptionEn: Anti-unwarranted complexity: do not add work or explanation for hypothetical reviewers, risks, or future needs. Take the smallest solution that satisfies real constraints, while keeping real safety checks and uncertainty disclosure. Applies to all main and delegated Agents.

title: Technical communication
description: 技术表达规范：术语一致、句子直陈、条件先于动作、精确给出量纲与边界并原样保留代码与引用。只约束技术答复与技术文档，不接管讲稿、答辩稿、创意或申报类文体。适用于全部主/子 Agent。
descriptionEn: Technical communication: keep terminology consistent, write direct sentences, put conditions before actions, state dimensions and boundaries precisely, and preserve code and quotations verbatim. Applies only to technical replies and documents, not to speeches, defense decks, creative writing, or grant proposals. Applies to all main and delegated Agents.

title: Engineering execution discipline for resource-constrained coding agents
titleZh: 工程执行纪律（资源受限模型）
description: 面向资源受限模型的详细工程执行纪律：任务边界与阻塞上报、真实仓库事实、语义编辑优先原生文件工具、一次性脚本生命周期、按实际影响分级的风险防护、比例化验证与按证据报告。对命中该模型路由的主/子 Agent 同等适用，不要求子 Agent 承担全项目验收。
descriptionEn: Detailed engineering execution discipline for resource-constrained models: task boundaries and blocking reports, real repository facts, semantic edits through native file tools, one-shot script lifecycle, risk controls proportional to actual impact, proportional verification, and evidence-based reporting. Applies equally to main and delegated Agents on the matching model route; it does not require a delegated Agent to accept whole-project acceptance.

title: Main-agent coordination and final integration (conditional extension)
titleZh: 主 Agent 统筹（条件扩展）
description: 主 Agent 统筹扩展：整体交付的验收边界、委派收益门槛、子任务目标与文件所有权、并行写入协调、子 Agent 证据复核与最终用户报告。只在主 Agent 生效，且不能替代共享执行核心。
descriptionEn: Main-Agent coordination extension: acceptance boundaries for overall delivery, the threshold for delegating work, subtask objectives and file ownership, parallel-write coordination, review of delegated evidence, and the final user report. Applies only to the main Agent and does not replace the shared execution core.

title: PowerShell execution guidance (conditional)
description: PowerShell 专有写法与失败语义：版本差异、单/双引号与子表达式求值、LiteralPath 与通配、cmdlet 非终止错误与 native 退出码、输出编码边界。仅在实际可执行 PowerShell 的 Agent 上生效，不强迫改用 PowerShell。
descriptionEn: PowerShell-specific syntax and failure semantics: version differences, single vs. double quotes and subexpression evaluation, LiteralPath vs. wildcards, non-terminating cmdlet errors vs. native exit codes, and output encoding boundaries. Applies only to Agents that can actually execute PowerShell; it does not require switching to PowerShell.

title: Credential-aware automation
description: 凭证感知的自动化：用项目既有认证、CLI、SDK 凭证链或运行时注入直接完成授权任务，不把秘密复制进命令参数、日志、diff 或交接；诊断优先取状态与非秘密字段，只在真实需要授权步骤时请用户参与。适用于全部主/子 Agent。
descriptionEn: Credential-aware automation: use the project's existing authentication, CLI, SDK credential chain, or runtime injection to complete authorized tasks directly. Do not copy secrets into command arguments, logs, diffs, or handoffs. Prefer status and non-secret fields for diagnosis, and involve the user only when an authorization step is genuinely required. Applies to all main and delegated Agents.
